_comment: Queries over imported CSV files. verify_sqlite.py loads each set into SQLite (with its own CSV reader) and compares the engine with the SQL; verify-ui.mjs imports the same files in the browser and checks the animated result.

cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM students
SELECT DISTINCT sid, name, major, year, cid, grade FROM students NATURAL JOIN enrolled
SELECT DISTINCT sid, name, major, year, cid, grade FROM students NATURAL LEFT JOIN enrolled
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(s.sid, e.sid), s.name, s.major, s.year, e.cid, e.grade FROM students s RIGHT JOIN enrolled e ON s.sid = e.sid
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(s.sid, e.sid), s.name, s.major, s.year, e.cid, e.grade FROM students s FULL JOIN enrolled e ON s.sid = e.sid
SELECT DISTINCT name, title FROM students NATURAL JOIN enrolled NATURAL JOIN courses
SELECT DISTINCT name FROM students NATURAL JOIN enrolled WHERE grade >= 90
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM students WHERE major = 'CS' OR year > 3
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM students WHERE name = 'O''Brien' OR name = 'Hopper, Grace'

cases.query: π[S1.name, S2.name](σ[S1.major = S2.major ∧ S1.sid < S2.sid](ρ[S1](students) × ρ[S2](students)))
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name, b.name FROM students a, students b WHERE a.major = b.major AND a.sid < b.sid

cases.query: π[n, cid](ρ[S(sid, n, m, y)](students) ⋈ enrolled)
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT name, cid FROM students NATURAL JOIN enrolled
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM students s JOIN enrolled e ON s.sid = e.sid AND e.grade < 90
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrolled e ON c.cid = e.cid
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM courses WHERE credits > 3
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(a.cid, b.cid) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cid FROM courses) a FULL JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT cid FROM enrolled) b ON a.cid = b.cid
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM enrolled, courses
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM enrolled WHERE grade = NULL
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM students WHERE NOT (major = 'CS')
SELECT DISTINCT name FROM students WHERE NOT (year > 2 OR major = 'Math')
SELECT DISTINCT name FROM students NATURAL LEFT JOIN enrolled WHERE NOT (grade > 80)

cases.query: project[name, cid](select[not(grade < 80) and year >= 2](students join enrolled))
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT name, cid FROM students NATURAL JOIN enrolled WHERE NOT (grade < 80) AND year >= 2
SELECT DISTINCT s."First Name", c.title FROM "Staff List" s JOIN courses c ON s.Dept = c.dept
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM "Staff List" WHERE "Staff ID" = '010'
SELECT DISTINCT "First Name", Phone FROM "Staff List" WHERE "Start Year" > 2019 OR Phone <> '555-0100'
